definition: An artifact is a file or collection of files consumed or produced by a pipeline action.
A repository stores a collection of source files, packages or images for tools to retrieve and manage.
A pull request lets collaborators review and comment on source changes before merging them into a branch.
A package manager publishes and retrieves versioned software dependencies from a package repository.
A CodeArtifact domain contains repositories that can share packages.
An upstream repository makes its CodeArtifact packages available through a downstream repository endpoint.
An external connection lets CodeArtifact retrieve packages from a public repository.
A registry stores container images that container tools can push and pull.
Tag immutability prevents an existing protected image tag from being overwritten.
A buildspec contains the commands and settings CodeBuild uses to run a build.
A noncurrent version is an older S3 object version retained after a newer version becomes current.
A symmetric KMS key is the key type CodePipeline supports for encrypting and decrypting S3 artifacts.
